episodes.title: The Doctor Sent to the Island
episodes.summary: Dreading his post, Do Jiui arrives on Pyeondongdo, meets Yuk Hari, and begins harsh island life.

episodes.title: The Woman Who Crosses the Line
episodes.summary: Do Jiui meets the mysterious nurse Yuk Hari, and their line-crossing house calls begin.

episodes.title: Getting Through Another Day
episodes.summary: The village chief makes Jiui an outcast. Meanwhile, Hari and Chiyeon are stranded overnight.

episodes.title: A Notorious Woman, a Pathetic Man
episodes.summary: Jiui is shaken by Hari's past and rumors, and a storm-hit emergency leaves him paralyzed by trauma.

episodes.title: Pyeondong Scandal
episodes.summary: Hari nurses Jiui amidst hospital gossip. Meanwhile, on Pyeondongdo, Mija is in critical condition.

episodes.title: An Unspeakable Secret
episodes.summary: Jiui and Hari's relationship is tested by Mija as the county governor schemes over Deokhwa's rescue.

episodes.title: Words Left Unsaid
episodes.summary: Torn between love and hurt, Jiui and the hurt Hari drift apart, and Mija's condition worsens.

episodes.title: I Can't Do It. I Can't Ignore You.
episodes.summary: Grieving her grandma, a downpour forces Hari to live with Jiui. Amid mix emotions, a secret emerges.

episodes.title: Courage to Forgive
episodes.summary: Jiui and Hari confirm their feelings, illness spreads on Jineondo, and a man appears before Jucheon.

episodes.title: It's Not Okay
episodes.summary: A crash shatters Jiui. As his first love Hwayeong returns, Hari must decide whether to let him go.

episodes.title: Reconciliation, Healing, And...
episodes.summary: Amid a confession and a breakup ahead, a misdiagnosed case returns, and Jiui stands at a crossroads.

episodes.title: If I Just Tough It Out, Things Will Work Out Somehow!
episodes.summary: The governor's risky deal could save the public health center. Will Jiui resist or compromise?
